name: story-first-automaton
notes: The reveal after room 7: Prvi Automat, ominous, for a ten-year-old.

slots.subject: The First Automaton: a very tall, thin, very old brass and black-iron machine man standing in the huge open doorway of a dark foundry, seen from below, fire glowing orange behind him so that he is mostly a looming silhouette. His head is a narrow riveted helmet with two small cold glowing round eyes and no mouth. A long strip of pale punched paper tape spills from a slot in his chest and curls down to the floor. In one long jointed hand he holds a thick old leather book, open, as if reading it. He is alone and very still. Unsettling and quiet, not gory, suitable for a children's storybook.
slots.camera: Low angle looking up at him from the ground.
slots.composition: The figure stands in the centre and fills most of the picture's height, the doorway framing him, deep shadows around.
slots.state: Completely still, sparks drifting faintly behind him.
